# catalyst Provider

Discover Zoho Catalyst projects, job pools, database schemas, File Store folders, Cache segments, Stratus buckets, Functions and application user access metadata. Manage NoSQL configuration items, Stratus objects/metadata, managed Node/Java SE/Python AppSail services, Node.js Functions, Gateway and Webhook/Function/AppSail schedules. Existing end-user role assignment is experimental and not live-verified. Authentication setup, role definitions, permissions and Connections provisioning are not implemented. Project management is experimental and depends on account API eligibility; table/schema and bucket provisioning remain manual prerequisites. Authenticate using either an access token or OAuth refresh credentials. Environment variables are recommended for secrets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catalyst = {
      source = "Edson-Edwin/catalyst"
    }
  }
}

# Set CATALYST_DATA_CENTER to your account's region (us, eu, in, au, ca, jp, sa).
# Set CATALYST_ACCESS_TOKEN, OR CATALYST_CLIENT_ID, CATALYST_CLIENT_SECRET,
# and CATALYST_REFRESH_TOKEN. Credentials are only needed for actual API reads.
provider "catalyst" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) Existing OAuth access token. Falls back to `CATALYST_ACCESS_TOKEN`. Cannot be combined with refresh credentials. Does not refresh automatically.
- `client_id` (String) OAuth client ID. Falls back to `CATALYST_CLIENT_ID`. Requires client_secret and refresh_token.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth client secret. Falls back to `CATALYST_CLIENT_SECRET`.
- `data_center` (String) Data center: `us`, `eu`, `in`, `au`, `ca`, `jp`, or `sa`. Falls back to `CATALYST_DATA_CENTER`, then `us`.
- `environment` (String) `Development` or `Production`. Falls back to `CATALYST_ENVIRONMENT`, then `Development`.
- `organization_id` (String) Optional organization ID for the `CATALYST-ORG` header. Falls back to `CATALYST_ORGANIZATION_ID`.
- `redirect_uri` (String) Optional registered redirect URI for OAuth refresh requests. Falls back to `CATALYST_REDIRECT_URI`. Omit for a Self Client.
- `refresh_token` (String, Sensitive) OAuth refresh token. Falls back to `CATALYST_REFRESH_TOKEN`. Access tokens are refreshed automatically and cached in memory.
